public_rationale: The commitments part holds. Anthropic's S-1 shows $518B in future infrastructure commitments, well into the hundreds of billions. The 'just as unprofitable' part does not hold on the plain reading of losses from running the business. Anthropic's H1 2026 operating loss was $0.69B, with an operating profit in Q2 and positive operating cash flow. OpenAI's operating loss was about $21.6B over the same half. Anthropic's GAAP net loss ($80.7B) is larger than OpenAI's, but $72.4B of it is a non-cash charge from its rising valuation, so it says little about how profitable the business is. Whether Anthropic 'can't keep' its promises is a future question and remains open.
limitations: The comparison depends on the measure: on GAAP net loss, Anthropic looks worse than OpenAI.
Anthropic's figures come from a news report of the S-1 rather than the filing itself; OpenAI's figures are press-reported investor numbers.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Anthropic is just as unprofitable as OpenAI and has made hundreds of billions of dollars' worth of promises it also can't keep.

statement.excerpt: It won’t matter that Anthropic is just as unprofitable or made hundreds of billions of dollars’ worth of promises it also can’t keep.

from_speaker: made hundreds of billions of dollars' worth of promises
our_interpretation: Three parts: (1) Anthropic's losses are comparable to OpenAI's; (2) Anthropic has made compute and spending commitments worth hundreds of billions of dollars; (3) it cannot meet them.

Plain reading of 'just as unprofitable': losses from running the business (operating loss) of similar size. GAAP net loss is also reported, with a note that non-cash fair-value charges dominate Anthropic's.
No period is named. I use the latest period public evidence covers up to the post: the first half of 2026 for losses, and commitments as reported for mid-2026.
Part (3) is about future performance and cannot be tested yet. It does not decide the outcome.
criteria.support_condition: Anthropic's H1 2026 losses are of similar size to OpenAI's, and its reported commitments total at least $200B.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Anthropic's H1 2026 operating losses are far smaller than OpenAI's (or it is operating profitably), or its commitments are well under $200B.
